import hashlib, json, time
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from transformers.integrations import flex_attention as flex
from transformers import masking_utils as masks
torch.set_num_threads(2)
torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
torch.manual_seed(20260907)
sources={name:hashlib.sha256(Path(source.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name,source in (("flex",flex),("masking",masks))}
assert sources=={"flex":"46655f4b8b528a75cdaa418e2fc6690fa4c2dd5e0180fe78900f4db0a7c83650","masking":"c159cd91c2a7fcafce04a8b6cbca55c320ce904b8ebf634383c97da5d9313ce3"}
print(json.dumps({"event":"identity","source_sha256":sources,"torch":torch.__version__}),flush=True)
with torch.no_grad():
    length=129
    query=torch.randn(8,32,length,128,device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    key=torch.randn(8,8,length,128,device="cuda",dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    value=torch.randn_like(key)
    mask=torch.ones(8,length,device="cuda",dtype=torch.bool)
    for index in range(8):
        mask[index,:index]=False
        if index%2==0:
            mask[index,-index-1:]=False
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    started=time.perf_counter()
    block=masks.flex_attention_mask(8,length,length,attention_mask=mask,device="cuda")
    output=flex.flex_attention_forward(torch.nn.Module().eval(),query,key,value,block,scaling=128**-0.5)[0]
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    cold_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started
    ids=torch.arange(length,device="cuda")
    keep=(ids[None,:,None]>=ids[None,None,:]) & mask[:,None,:]
    predicate=block.mask_mod(torch.arange(8,device="cuda")[:,None,None],0,ids[None,:,None],ids[None,None,:])
    exact_mask=torch.equal(predicate,keep)
    scores=torch.einsum("bghqd,bgkd->bghqk",query.reshape(8,8,4,length,128).double(),key.double())*128**-0.5
    scores.masked_fill_(~keep[:,None,None,:,:],-torch.inf)
    valid=keep.any(-1)
    weights=torch.where(valid[:,None,None,:,None],scores.softmax(-1),torch.zeros_like(scores))
    oracle=torch.einsum("bghqk,bgkd->bghqd",weights,value.double()).reshape(8,32,length,128).transpose(1,2)
    errors={}
    try:
        torch.testing.assert_close(output.double(),oracle,rtol=0.005,atol=0.0005)
    except AssertionError as error:
        errors["fp64_oracle"]=str(error)
    finite=bool(torch.isfinite(output).all())
    empty_query_count=int((~valid).sum())
    empty_exact_zero=bool(torch.all(output[~valid]==0))
    result={"event":"prefill_numeric","query_length":length,"key_length":length,"batch":8,"exact_mask":exact_mask,"all_finite":finite,"fully_masked_queries":empty_query_count,"fully_masked_output_exact_zero":empty_exact_zero,"max_abs_fp64_error":float((output.double()-oracle).abs().max()),"errors":errors,"cold_mask_compile_call_seconds":cold_seconds,"semantic_checks_passed":exact_mask and finite and empty_query_count==28 and empty_exact_zero and not errors}
    print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    if not result["semantic_checks_passed"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Causal prefill semantics failed; result retained")
